subject: general
question:
Select the figure from the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ff8014b450d67be5fa11191840d4c5fbc62af379ab2faea694e7178deaece35a.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Step I: The small crossed line is shifted two places in clockwise direction.

Step II: The circle has been shaded in alternate figure.

Step III: The circles are shifted one place in anticlockwise direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3b70768d43e97930006d289d5fae2d337dfec316440e3c1da4073509771605c7.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.
